title: Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir: Favourite tourist spot, Complete Tourist Guide to Kashmir’s Snow Paradise
content:
Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir: Complete Travel Guide for Tourists

Gulmarg is one of the most beautiful hill stations in Kashmir and a dream destination for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and honeymooners. Known for its snow-covered mountains, green meadows, and Asia’s highest cable car, Gulmarg offers breathtaking views in every season. Whether you are planning a winter snow trip or a summer escape, Gulmarg has something special for everyone.

Why is Gulmarg Famous ?

Gulmarg is famous for:

  • Snowfall and winter sports
  • Gulmarg Gondola (Asia’s highest cable car)
  • Skiing and snowboarding
  • Lush green meadows in summer
  • Romantic views and peaceful surroundings
  • It is also one of the best ski destinations in India.

Where is Gulmarg Located ?

Gulmarg is located in the Baramulla district of Jammu and Kashmir, about 50 km from Srinagar. It sits at an altitude of around 2,650 meters above sea level, making it one of the highest hill resorts in India.

Best Time to Visit Gulmarg

Winter (December to February)

  • Best for snow lovers and skiing
  • Heavy snowfall
  • Perfect for honeymoon and adventure

Summer (May to June)

  • Pleasant weather
  • Green meadows and flowers
  • Ideal for sightseeing and photography

Autumn (September to October)

  • Clear skies and fewer tourists
  • Beautiful golden landscapes

Avoid monsoon (July-August) due to landslides and travel issues

Top Places to Visit in Gulmarg

  • Gulmarg Gondola :The Gulmarg Gondola is the second-highest cable car in the world. It takes you up to Mount Apharwat and offers stunning views of snow-covered peaks. More about it…
  • Apharwat Peak : Apharwat Peak remains snow-covered most of the year and is a favorite spot for skiing and photography. More about it..
  • Gulmarg Golf Course : One of the highest golf courses in the world, surrounded by pine trees and mountains. More about it..
  •  Strawberry Valley : A quiet and scenic spot, perfect for nature walks and photography. More about it..
  •  Maharani Temple : A small but beautiful temple located on a hill, offering peaceful vibes and lovely views. More about it..

Best Food to Try in Gulmarg

Must-try local dishes:

  • Rogan Josh
  • Dum Aloo
  • Kashmiri Pulao
  • Kahwa (Kashmiri tea)

Why You Should Visit Gulmarg

Gulmarg is not just a tourist place; it is an experience. From snow adventures to peaceful nature views, Gulmarg is perfect for families, couples, and solo travelers. If you want to see the true beauty of Kashmir, Gulmarg should be on top of your travel list.

It is ideal for all types of travelers, from nature lovers to honeymoon couples and adventure seekers. A well-planned trip to Gulmarg offers unforgettable experiences in every season.
